Why Gyms and Squads Order Factory-Direct

Cheer is an expensive sport for families, and the uniform is a large part of why. A competition set bought through the usual channels often costs a multiple of what the same garment costs to make - and the gym has little say over fabric weight, stitch quality or how the rhinestones are set.

Ordering direct puts those decisions back with the program. You choose the knit weight, whether the shell is sublimated or appliquéd, and how the metallic work is applied. Twenty sets covers a competition team, mixed youth-to-adult sizing is standard, and practice wear can be reordered in smaller batches through the season. Test us first with a trial order, or browse the wider sportswear range.

Questions

What is the minimum order for custom cheer uniforms?

20 sets per design - a competition squad with spares. Youth and adult sizes mix freely in one order, and practice wear can be added at 20 pieces per style.

How much does a custom cheer uniform cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours, because competition pieces vary enormously with metallic, sequin and rhinestone work. Comparable sublimated baselines on our published pricing page start around $18 at team quantities, with detailing itemised separately.

Can you match our gym's existing colors?

Yes. Send a Pantone reference, a fabric swatch or a photo of the current uniform and we colour-match in the sample, which you approve before bulk production begins.

Do you make practice wear as well as competition uniforms?

Yes - crops, sports bras, shorts and leggings in gym colors, from 20 pieces per style. Most programs reorder practice wear more often than competition sets, so we keep your artwork on file.

How long does a cheer uniform order take?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 3-4 weeks for competition pieces, express DDP delivery 3-7 days. Start before the season, not during it.
